title: Giving Simple Design Feedback
summary: Students learn beginner-friendly English for identifying one design strength, explaining why it works, making one polite suggestion, and stating one revision step.
essential_question: How can I give simple, respectful feedback on a fashion design in English?
professional_context: Week 13 connects English to early studio critique, caption revision, sketch review, and peer response before the final mini design board. Students build simple feedback language they can use when responding to a look, sketch, or design board in class.
language_focus: positive feedback such as I like the ... and The strongest part is ...
reason language with because and works well
polite suggestion language with could and maybe you could
revision verbs such as add, change, use, clarify, and simplify
short feedback-note writing and teacher-supported peer critique speaking
grammar_focus: revision verbs: add, change, use, clarify, simplify
teacher_preparation: Preview the Week 13 opener image, the reusable image A to image D feedback gallery, and the numbered listening script before class.
Keep visible sentence frames for I like the ..., It works well because ..., The strongest part is ..., You could ..., Maybe you could ..., and I will revise ....
Keep the main writing task as a six-line structured feedback card with one optional challenge line. Do not turn it into a paragraph or a word-count assignment.
Check that the image A to image D gallery keys, the numbered listening script, the question labels, and the correct answers all match exactly.
Prepare quick correction support for because clauses, could for polite suggestion, singular and plural agreement, and short revision-plan language.
Decide whether students will view the reusable gallery on screen, with printed cards, or with teacher-selected critique images during the speaking session.
student_deliverables: Completion of the Week 13 opener selections about one feedback-ready design image.
Completion of the feedback phrase matching set and secondary phrase-function matching checks.
Completion of eight single-choice classifications for positive comment, reason, suggestion, and revision plan.
Reading-comprehension responses matching short feedback comments to image A to image D and answering detail questions.
Listening-comprehension responses identifying images, strengths, and suggestions from one short numbered audio clip.
Completion of six fill-blank feedback frames using because, could, and revision language.
A scaffolded Design Feedback Note plus Revision Plan Card with six required lines and one optional challenge line.
Two corrected Week 13 feedback sentences saved after review.
A short teacher-observed mini critique using one selected gallery image and supported feedback frames.
